question: How are the knowers classified and what happens to the trembling knowers at death?
premises: The knowers are of two kinds: trembling and otherwise.
Those with trembling knowledge have an unstable realization.
At the end of the body, the trembling knowers clearly become Shiva.
inference: Even an unstable form of knowledge leads to Shivahood at the time of death.
plain_english: But those who are knowers are of two kinds, according to whether their knowledge trembles or not. Among them, those whose knowledge trembles clearly become Shiva at the end of the body.
